scope: Production native f64 optimized biquad gain/phase and endpoint impulse validation; optional ML separate. EQ remains partial.

before.tiny_cut_failure: PeakMatched/-0.000001 dB/10 Hz probe at center 1000 Hz, Q 0.1, fs 48000 failed to approach identity.

design.shelves: Preserve fixed-slope poles and DC/Nyquist/geometric-midpoint gain constraints. Use half-angle endpoint sums and the closed-form positive b0-b2=2*A*sqrt(2*A)*sin(w). Removes power subtraction/small quadratic divide and selects minimum phase for both signs. Q remains ignored by native shelf slope.
design.peak: Keep boost poles r=exp(-pi*f/(Q*fs)), angle w=2*pi*f/fs. Unity endpoints fix b1 and b0+b2; center complex power fixes positive b0-b2. Stable factor uses exp_m1 for 1-r and a sum of nonnegative powers. Cuts swap boost numerator/denominator and normalize; zero gain is exact identity. No claim of complete analog bandwidth matching.
design.preset_behavior: Names/fields unchanged; negative-gain audio intentionally corrected. No callback data structure or allocation added.

native_public_matrix.reference: Shelves use independent prewarped analog-polynomial bilinear model. Peak uses unity endpoint sums and a complex center-response spectral factor, with no production coefficient helpers. Gain/Q per-stage rules modeled independently.

actual_coefficients.criterion: All actual f64 coefficients finite; all three second-order Jury margins positive for denominator and numerator, certifying stable/minimum-phase roots beyond the impulse prefix.
